Question: Of the following, which gives the best upper bound for the value of f(N) where f is a solution to the recurrence f(2N + 1) = f(2N) = f(N) + log N for N >= 1, with f(1) = 0?

Options: 
A. O(N log(log N))
B. O(N^2)
C. O(N)
D. O(log N)
E. O((log N)^2)
F. O(N log N)
G. O(2^N)
H. O(1)
I. O(log N) + 0(1)
J. O(N^2 log N)

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
